description.narrative:
Diakonia har ansökt om finansiering av egeninsats om 726 670 SEK för EU-projektet "Development Initiative for Northern Uganda (DINU)" under 2020-2021.
Insatsen syftar till att:
1. "Enhance Gender Responsive Accountability and Citizen Empowerment (GRACE) in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda."
2. "Strengthen the capacity of communities and Non-State Actors to participate in local governance, prioritize Gender Responsive planning and Budgeting and joint service delivery monitoring in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda."
Projektet kommer att genomföras på lokal nivå i Uganda och Diakonia kommer att arbeta i samverkan med civilsamhällesorganisationen The Civil Society Budget Advocacy Group (CSBAG). Diakonia är huvudsökande organisation och har det övergripande ansvaret för projektets implementering och koordinering.
Den aktuella insatsen har EU-kommissionens referensnummer FED 2019-412-819. Insatsen har en total budget på 266 667 EUR, vilket motsvarar cirka 2 809 590 SEK. Av detta har Diakonia beviljats 200 000 EUR från EU-kommissionen och ansöker om 726 670 SEK (cirka 25%) från Sida.

Diakonia has applied to Sida for funding of 726 670 SEK to carry out the EU-project "Development Initiative for Northern Uganda (DINU)" during 2020-2021.
The project aims to:
1. "Enhance Gender Responsive Accountability and Citizen Empowerment (GRACE) in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda."
2. "Strengthen the capacity of communities and Non-State Actors to participate in local governance, prioritize Gender Responsive planning and Budgeting and joint service delivery monitoring in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda."
The project will be conducted on a local level in Uganda and Diakonia will collaborate with the civil society organisation "The Civil Society Budget Advocacy Group" (CSBAG). Diakonia is lead applicant to Sida and has the overall responsibility for the coordination and implementation of the project.
The contribution has the EU Commission reference number: FED 2019-412-819. The contribution's total budget is 266 667 EUR, which corresponds to approximately 2 809 590 SEK. The requested support from Sida is 726 670 SEK, which corresponds to 25% of the total budget.

Overall objective: Enhance Gender Responsive Accountability and Citizen Empowerment (GRACE) in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda. Specific objective: To strengthen the capacity of local government, communities, and NonState Actors to prioritize Gender Responsive Budgeting (GRB) through participatory planning, budgeting, and joint service delivery monitoring in Alebtong and Amolatar Districts of Northern Uganda.

By end of 2021, the level of stakeholders participation in planning, budgeting and service delivery monitoring increased to 58% in 2021 from 42.8% in 2020 and 17.5 at baseline survey. Due to the availability of a platform to engage duty bearers by the community, there was an increased. By the end of the project, the number of participants increased to 323 from 204 representing an increase of 58%. The participation of women also increased from 86 to 120 representing 40%. This increase in participation would probably continue growing if the project life was longer signifying the desire to acquire knowledge and participate in governance and accountability processes. Citizens meaningfully participate and engage in the planning and budgeting process at village, parish, subcounty, district, service delivery units, projects delivery and have their priorities being part of the national planning process, In sectors and Parliament
The engagements brought together technical staff from the departments of Health, Education, Roads, Water and Environment, Production, Community Based Services who discussed priority interventions per department which can be integrated in the district budgets for FY 2022/23. Issue papers were developed by departments, and these informed the drafting of the National Budget Framework paper as well as the Department presentations at the respective district budget conferences.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
